Explain how fungal wilt and root rot diseases affect Malabar neem nurseries and main fields.

Root rot, induced by Ganoderma spp., not only kills entire trees but also reduces the wood's market value, severely impacting both nurseries and the main fields where Malabar neem is cultivated.
